title: Pre-INTERNET Security Corrections, Isolated Pilot Build & Verification Policy Transition

acceptance_criteria.description: PilotAuthorizationGate issues PilotAdmissionTicket with internal ticketId tracked in an authoritative ledger binding context, generation, operation, deadline, budgets, and request attributes; forged or modified tickets are rejected.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-451: Forged ticketId and .copy()-modified PilotAdmissionTicket fields rejected fail-closed.

acceptance_criteria.description: Intermediate layers verify tickets non-destructively while PilotClientFactory atomically consumes each ticket once at network dispatch, blocking replay across MockWebServer.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-452: Intermediate verify succeeds; first network dispatch hits MockWebServer once; replay blocked with 0 extra requests.

acceptance_criteria.description: PilotCapabilityRestrictedAuthGateway enforces exact authorized account and calling code before credential serialization or network dispatch.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-453: Direct gateway call with different account in same region produces 0 MockWebServer requests.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot admission, request verification, and expiry handling rely strictly on injected AuthMonotonicClock (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime) with zero System.nanoTime deadlines.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-454: Zero System.nanoTime in pilot gate/ticket; deadlines strictly governed by injected AuthMonotonicClock.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deadline expiry (including simulated deep sleep) triggers complete generation-fenced 9-step cleanup rather than only clearing activeContext.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-455: Deterministic deep-sleep clock jump triggers full generation-fenced cleanup without affecting newer runs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Explicit pilot buildType builds com.weback.robot.pilot with INTERNET only in src/pilot/AndroidManifest.xml while preserving INTERNET-free debug APK (com.weback.robot).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-456: assembleDebug, assemblePilot, lintPilot, and testPilotUnitTest pass with isolated manifests.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: ./gradlew assembleDebug assemblePilot lintDebug lintPilot testDebugUnitTest testPilotUnitTest + apkanalyzer manifest print (PASS)

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot APK provides separate storage sandbox, side-by-side installable permissions/authorities, clear pilot labeling, default offline startup, zero auto-auth, and zero live commands.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-457: Pilot BuildConfig/labels/authorities verified; DefaultAppContainer boots OfflineDefault.

acceptance_criteria.description: No self-referential final APK checksum embedded inside APK; external artifact verification and RuntimeAppIdentity are cleanly separated.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-456: RuntimeAppIdentity uses BuildConfig without embedded APK SHA-256.

acceptance_criteria.description: apk_validator.py supports --connectivity-policy {offline,pilot} with offline default, binding expected APK path, package ID, and INTERNET requirement/prohibition.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-458: Selftests and live validator runs verify offline and pilot modes and reject cross-artifact substitution.

acceptance_criteria.description: apk_validator.py preserves cleartext, backup, networkSecurityConfig, signature, vendor binary, and DEX package checks in both modes.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-458: Negative selftests confirm all security invariants remain enforced in both offline and pilot modes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Proposed verification policy preserves all 7 existing checks, adds pilot lint/unit/build/apk checks, measures runtime/duplication, and documents smaller alternative.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-459: Proposed 11-check policy executes in fast lane and runtime/alternative evaluation is documented.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: policies/checks.json (11/11 PASS in fast lane) + specs/changes/FCT-004B/proposal.md §3

acceptance_criteria.description: Baseline policy (e688b6...) and proposed candidate policy both execute and pass evidence audits with TRANSITION_AUTHORIZATION inactive.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-459: Candidate lane baseline audit and fast lane proposed audit both PASS.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: verification/run.py --lane candidate (baseline e688b6...) + verification/run.py --lane fast --config policies/checks.json + evidence.py audit (PASS)

acceptance_criteria.description: Both candidate APKs, acceptance evidence ZIP, and physical-device verification checklist are prepared without unauthorized device execution.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-460: Artifacts exported and device acceptance checklist prepared; TEST-PILOT-414 remains NOT_RUN.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: specs/changes/FCT-004B/device-acceptance-plan.md prepared; physical device execution remains NOT_RUN until explicit human authorization
